animations.name: Light Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Animate a continuous crouching light jab with clear wind-up preparation and smooth progressive motion spread across the entire clip, pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: staying anchored in the low kneeling crouch on the baseline without standing up, he first leans his torso visibly back and pulls his FAR left shoulder and fist clearly back near his chest to wind up; then he shifts his torso forward and extends his FAR left arm progressively inch by inch horizontally right into full jab reach while keeping his NEAR right arm bent in guard by his chin so his face stays visible; finally he retracts smoothly through intermediate angles back into the exact starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, beard, outfit, boots, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
